description.value: Glacier Creek is an on-mountain restaurant at Whistler Blackcomb, one of North America's largest ski and bike resorts. Its coordinates place it mid-mountain on Whistler, making it a natural stop for riders using the Whistler Mountain Bike Park during summer operations. The building is a dedicated structure serving the mountain's dining needs across seasons.

The fetched website content is the general whistlerblackcomb.com homepage and subpages; it confirms the resort is operational and mentions 'On Mountain Dining' and the Whistler Mountain Bike Park in navigation, but contains no Glacier Creek-specific content to verify individual amenities. All amenity values are therefore drawn from OSM tags, with Wi-Fi and washrooms being the only positively evidenced items.
